theorems.name: Submission.rpn_massOn_le_mul_measure_diff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (ξ x) β) ^ 2 = 1) → ∀ (Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P) (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → (∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' K) = 0) → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W \ K)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
